name: Milkshake Momma (Mama) Orange Beach
description: Milkshake Momma was founded in 2019 in Crawford, Alabama as part of Southern Roots Country Store and Cafe. The business is known for Freak Shakes and Southern-style comfort foods. Founded by Sylvia Nolan, the concept has expanded to multiple locations including Columbus, GA and Orange Beach, AL. The company emphasizes community engagement, outstanding customer service, and a family-friendly atmosphere.
